AnyCareer.Description: A survival career: earn Cash from delivery and kill jobs and small finds in houses and shops, and trade with nine traders spread over the map (Hayzeco Autoparts, Builder, Junkyard, Grocer, Medic, Marine & Air, Mod Shop, Outfitter, Gunsmith). Survival only; the host runs it. Trader map pins need AnyMap 1.0.1 or later. Standalone mod, not part of a bundle. Anymaker 0.1.27 only.
